state.description: Charges keyed by `ch_…` id, one per confirmation attempt (failed attempts included).
Customer objects keyed by their `cus_…` id. `email` is not unique.
Invoice items keyed by `ii_…` id; `invoice: null` marks a pending item.
Invoices keyed by `in_…` id with embedded lines and payments.
Row `counters` (`{ next }`, one sequence for every object type) and row `account` (the simulated Stripe account rendered into invoices, charges and permission errors).
PaymentIntents keyed by `pi_…` id; `invoice` is a private back-reference to the invoice the intent pays.
Materialised synthetic cards keyed by `pm_…` id; `outcome` is the private test-card behaviour and is never returned.
Prices keyed by `price_…` id (immutable in this Tool).
Subscriptions keyed by `sub_…` id with embedded items (period fields live on the items).

List the card payment methods attached to a customer (GET /v1/customers/:id/payment_methods, GET /v1/payment_methods?customer=).

connections.title: Stripe agent-toolkit MCP tool names (create_customer, list_invoices, create_refund, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to STRIPE_MCP_URL with STRIPE_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Sixteen per-resource tool names of the Stripe agent toolkit are exposed next to the canonical stripe.<operation> names and return the full REST objects.

connections.title: Official Stripe SDK or CLI pointed at this Tool (Bearer secret key, /v1 REST subset)
connections.instructions: Pass these to your test process only. stripe-node: new Stripe(STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, { host, port, protocol }) parsed from STRIPE_API_BASE; stripe-python: stripe.api_base = STRIPE_API_BASE; Stripe CLI: --api-base. The Tool speaks the /v1 REST subset listed in its README; HTTP Basic auth and API v2 are not accepted.
